rust_mcp.finding: The official Rust SDK is a real second released 2026-07-28 Tasks runtime comparator. Its bundled TaskManager is process-memory state behind Arc<Mutex<HashMap<...>>>, assigns a fresh UUID on every spawn, and shutdown drains the map. The exact TaskDemo embeds TaskManager::new and directly calls self.tasks.spawn for task-backed slow_sum, with no caller-stable create-or-get identity in the bundled helper/example. This is scoped to the bundled manager/example; ServerHandler task methods remain overridable.
rust_mcp.execution_scope: source-equivalent behavioral model; upstream Rust crate not compiled or run

openhands.finding: Exact ConversationState source supports an R7 startup-only commit shape: pure full-plan validation, one off-object final BASE_STATE snapshot write under the existing write guard, silent synchronization of already-validated recovery bookkeeping without ConversationState.__setattr__, then marker cleanup. Ordinary public assignment is unsuitable because it autosaves incrementally and last_user_message_id can emit a state-change callback; context-manager exceptional exit is not rollback because dirty state is flushed on exit.
